description:
Comma is your personal AI agent. Give it a task in chat, and it does the work in your apps and files on its own cloud computer, day and night. Follow along from your iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch.

HAND OFF THE BUSYWORK
Ask once: draft the release notes, compare flights, research CRM options, prepare for tomorrow's meetings. A quick question gets an answer in chat. Bigger work becomes a Task that keeps going while your phone is in your pocket.

START EVERY DAY AHEAD
Routines prepares a daily briefing from the apps you connect, such as Slack, Gmail, Linear, GitHub, and Notion. It lists what needs you today. Tap an item to start on it.

ONLY YOUR DECISIONS WAIT FOR YOU
A Task that needs your decision waits in Needs Review. See what is running, what waits for you, and what is done in one list. Live Activities show progress on your Lock Screen.

SCHEDULE THE WORK
Run a Task every morning, or when something changes: a competitor briefing at 9:00, or new review comments on a pull request.

TALK TO COMMA
Start a voice call on your iPhone or Apple Watch, or dictate a message.

BUILD YOUR OWN MINI APPS
Describe a tool, such as a trip cost splitter, and use it right on your phone. Share it with a link.

CODE AND COMPUTERS
Start a coding Task on a repository, read the diff, and merge the pull request from your phone. Open the agent's remote browser, or view the screen of a computer in your Workspace.

YOU STAY IN CONTROL
• Choose the model for the work, or add your own API key.
• Connected apps get scoped access that you can revoke at any time.
• Your conversations, prompts, and files are never used to train AI models.
• Comma is open source.

A Comma account and an internet connection are required. Mini Apps require iOS 18.4 or later.
promotionalText: Hand off the busywork. Comma works on your tasks around the clock on its own cloud computer, briefs you every morning, and leaves only the decisions to you.
